_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment: never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Adds three fields to GLLine so a segment report can show a result instead of a gross total of postings. signedAmount is declared as a materialised calculation (credit positive, debit negative), so a sum over it is the result. accountClass and countsInResult are stamped by GLLineResultStampListener when the line's transaction is posted or reversed, because a line cannot see its account's type or its transaction's state through a calculation. Historic lines are stamped once by the StampGlLineResults repair step.

signedAmount.description: The amount with its sign: positive on the credit side, negative on the debit side. Calculated when the line is saved, so the sum of a segment's lines is its result.
signedAmount.title: Signed amount

accountClass.description: Whether the line's account is a profit and loss account (revenue or expenses) or a balance sheet account, as the chart of accounts said when the transaction was posted.
accountClass.title: Account class

countsInResult.description: True while the line's transaction is posted and not reversed. A draft line, and the lines of a reversed transaction and of its reversal, do not count.
countsInResult.title: Counts in result
